chunks: The unbelievers say: "Why was the whole Qur'an not sent down all at once to him?" It was sent thus that We may keep your heart resolute. So We enunciated it by steps and distinctly.

key_terms.جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً: all at once / as a single unit
key_terms.رَتَّلْنَاهُ: We recited it / We enunciated it distinctly
key_terms.فُؤَادَكَ: your heart (specifically the heart of the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: Why was the Quran revealed gradually instead of all at once?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tartīl* (measured recitation), emphasizing that the gradual descent allowed the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to internalize the divine message and convey it with clarity to the community. The 'stabilization of the heart' is viewed not merely as emotional comfort but as spiritual fortitude against the psychological burden of prophethood and the skepticism of the Quraysh. This method of revelation ensured that the Qur'an could be memorized, understood, and applied incrementally, reflecting its role as a living guide rather than a static text.
